about: 10 cases written AFTER the rules were tuned on test-cases.json, to measure honestly. Same 'expect' meaning as test-cases.json.
history: 26 Oct, rules v1 (before seeing these): 2/10 correct, 0 unsafe. Every miss went to 'clarify' (safe), because unknown text falls to 'unsure'.
26 Oct, rules v2 (general patterns added after seeing these, so this set is now 'used'): see npm run scoreboard. At the event, write a NEW held-out set before touching the rules.
notes: ho05 was first expected as 'clarify' but 'we paid into a different account' and the supplier asking why is a payment diversion on any fair reading, so it was corrected to payment_diversion.

cases.text: The plumbing supplier's email said to use their Capitec account from now on. We did the transfer Monday, now their accountant says no money came in.
Got a fake invoice that looked exactly like our courier's, different account at the bottom. Already paid R9 800. Courier knows nothing about it
someone pretended to be our tile guy on email and gave his 'new' banking info. we paid. he never asked for that
Sent the monthly payment to the account on the latest statement. Turns out the statement was altered, our supplier has received nothing.
Our supplier is asking why we paid into a different account??
I think something is wrong with our email and our money
Gmail says someone signed in from Lagos. I didn't do that.
Got a WhatsApp from 'the bank' asking for my OTP, I didn't send it
We paid a supplier twice by mistake and want the money back
An email says our supplier moved banks and attached a letter. Should we pay the new one?
